note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). The total and every value are hypothetical placeholders labelled as such; segment lengths follow only the supplied values. No share rule or legal doctrine is stated and nothing is attributed or decided; the two supplied allocations (A proposed, B alternative) are listed at equal weight and neither is preferred. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision (standing stress-cap rule, docs/AUTHORING.md item 20, from LAW-0687/0689–0692; scene-area floor >= 0.20 of the frame as in accepted LAW-0701/0705). True driver: the 1:1 box — the physical scene (rail, shelf, trays, floor) must cover >= 0.20 of the frame area while every text stays >= 16 px. Fallbacks tried: panel beside the scene (four-line chips) and below it, a compact rail zone, value chips staggered on two rows, a taller rail zone that fills the box. Measured, rendered at 1080p (2026-10-05; pre-cap copy production/scratch/causation-10/LAW-0717.stress-precap.json): full counts (four events, two totals described, two accounts put forward, one labelled connector, two notes) → 1:1 scene area 0.086 (16 px), 9:16 0.189; one total, one account, one note → 1:1 0.175; three events, one account, no connector note → 1:1 0.266. The stress therefore keeps the maximum four events and caps the other counts at the baseline's: one total described, no account put forward, no connector note, one note (baseline 1 / 0 / 0 / 1); every text field keeps its near-maximum length. After the cap: 1:1 16 px, scene area 0.235; 9:16 0.226; 16:9 20 px, 0.321.
